mapper.sql: id, elder_id, drug_name, dosage, frequency, take_relation, remind_times, start_date, end_date, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_plan (elder_id, drug_name, dosage, frequency, take_relation, remind_times, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{elderId}, #{drugName}, #{dosage}, #{frequency}, #{takeRelation}, #{remindTimes}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM medication_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM medication_plan WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM medication_plan WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE medication_plan SET drug_name = #{drugName}, dosage = #{dosage}, frequency = #{frequency}, take_relation = #{takeRelation}, remind_times = #{remindTimes}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE medication_plan SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE medication_plan SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE medication_plan SET deleted = 1 WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} AND deleted = 0
